question: What native refresh and exact-plugin reinstall behavior does deepagents-code 0.1.83 expose for an OpenPlugin marketplace plugin?

isolation.note: The probe ran remotely in a newly created sandbox. Its generated source, HTTPS Git server, virtual environment, dcode state, and HOME all lived under sandbox /tmp.

execution.command: vercel sandbox exec --scope charfeng1s-projects --timeout 12m plugnz-dcode-0183-proof-final-20261009 -- bash /tmp/dcode-native-update-0.1.83-20261009.sh

observations.result: Initial native install used hashed marketplace, plugin, and version directories.
dcode plugin marketplace update proof-market exited 2; the accepted subcommands were list, ls, add, and remove.
After upstream marker-v1 changed to marker-v2 at version 0.1.0, marketplace re-add, exact-plugin reinstall, and internal auto_update_plugins() all left marker-v1 active.
With extensions.com.langchain.deepagents.code.autoUpdate=true, internal auto_update_plugins() advanced 0.1.0 to 0.1.1 and installed marker-v3-version-bump.
With extensions.com.langchain.deepagents.code.autoUpdate=false at upstream version 0.1.2, internal auto_update_plugins() returned an empty tuple and active state remained at 0.1.1.
After the marketplace source had been refreshed, public dcode plugin install proof-plugin@proof-market advanced active state from 0.1.1 to 0.1.2 despite autoUpdate=false.

claimBoundary: The exact-plugin reinstall followed an internal updater call that had refreshed marketplace source while declining background activation. It proves public exact-plugin install can apply a declared newer version from an already-refreshed marketplace; it does not prove install alone refreshes a stale marketplace clone.
The probe establishes dcode 0.1.83 behavior only. It does not turn OpenPlugin format or open-source status into a cross-harness lifecycle guarantee.
The final case is an explicit autoUpdate=false opt-out, not an absent extension.

resources.scope: Entire final sandbox session through stop: creation, preflight, one corrected probe run, and stop-time snapshot creation.

cleanup.verification: Filtered sandbox and snapshot lists were empty; snapshot get reported status=deleted and expiration=deleted.
